label: Studio Light Rig
description: Automotive studio lighting craft — how the paint, glass and metal are actually lit, written for machines instead of faces.

items.name: overhead-softbox-line
items.text: one room-length overhead softbox laying a single unbroken specular line from nose to tail, the quality of the surfacing judged by how cleanly that line flows

items.name: light-painting-pass
items.text: a long-exposure light-painting pass, a handheld LED tube walked the length of the body until every panel carries one continuous liquid highlight

items.name: dark-field-rim
items.text: dark-field lighting, black walls and two strip boxes raking the flanks so the machine reads as bright carved edges over deep paint

items.name: inspection-tunnel
items.text: rows of diffused tube light overhead like a paint-inspection tunnel, zebra stripes bending across the surfacing and proving it true

items.name: single-fresnel
items.text: one large fresnel set high and far for hard sun discipline, a single clean shadow thrown long across the studio floor
items.text_short: hard single fresnel, one long shadow

items.name: bounce-cove-wrap
items.text: the whole cove used as a bounce, wraparound shadowless white with shutlines and intakes drawn purely by occlusion

items.name: scan-stripes
items.text: structured-light scanner stripes sweeping the bodywork, thin cyan contour lines mapping every change of curvature they cross

items.name: pin-spot-black
items.text: pin spots out of blackness picking one wheel, the badge and the lamp graphic, everything else held at the edge of visibility

items.name: sunset-gel-gradient
items.text: a smooth amber-to-violet gel gradient washed across the backdrop, the machine held under a neutral white key so the paint stays honest
